title: Update docs/qa/legacy auth scenarios and docs/planning upgrade-flow UX specs for the credential-less offline-account redesign

evidence.quote: Password hashed with argon2id, stored in local SQLite | None. No sync, no backup
AUTH-06: Email/password signup (local-born, airplane mode) ... Enter a password that meets strength requirements
The argon2id hash in SQLite is updated to the new password
For security, please enter your account password. This is the same password you use to sign in

why: signup_screen.dart's offline path is documented in-code as credential-less ('no email, no password') per the 2026-06-14 product decision, confirmed still true today. All 6 docs above (linked from docs/index.md's active reference sections, none carrying a staleness banner) still describe/design around a password-based local-born account with argon2id verification. A tester running AUTH-06/SET-23 cannot find the password-entry UI they're told to test (false failure or wasted time); an engineer implementing the upgrade flow could copy ux-upgrade-flow-spec.md §5.2's 'verify existing password' step into new code, which cannot work once `passwordHash` is null for a credential-less account.
recommendation: Add the same staleness-banner pattern already used well elsewhere in this repo (two-database-architecture.md, v1-developer-roadmap.md) to these 6 files, or rewrite the affected scenarios/screens to match the credential-less flow and the convert-on-reconnect upgrade entry point.
acceptance_criteria: Each of the 6 files carries a dated staleness banner pointing at the current onboarding/upgrade design, or its password-signup content is rewritten to match signup_screen.dart.
docs/index.md links only to auth docs that are current or explicitly marked historical.

corrections: docs/planning/ux-upgrade-flow-spec.md 'For security, please enter your account password' quote is at line 108, not 105; text itself matches verbatim.
